t: You're looking at St Cuthbert's, an Anglican church at 50 Philbeach Gardens in Earls Court. It's Grade I listed, which puts it among the most highly protected buildings in the country. The architect was Hugh Roumieu Gough, who lived from 1843 to 1904. He was a Fellow of the Royal Institute of British Architects and practised mainly in the London area, so this church is part of his work close to home.
